metadata.adaptation: Converted from paired 106-point / 42-hand-point NPY matrices to hand-only Canonical Skeleton v1; camera axes and the shared bounds fallback normalization are applied. Unobserved hand frames remain marked invisible; no pose or points are synthesized.
metadata.sourceNonHandPoints: 64 points retained by source but not mapped; names and semantics are undocumented.
metadata.sourceHandGroupOrder: first 21 points -> left, second 21 points -> right (inferred; dataset does not publish an index map).
metadata.sourceFrameRate: unknown; source NPY does not store timestamps or FPS.
metadata.templateSampling: uniformly resampled to at most 16 frames, matching the runtime feature-vector limit.
metadata.timebase: source frame index; DTW uses ordered frames, not elapsed seconds.
